name: prepion
description: Herramientas de calidad del monorepo Prepion: hooks de Git, formato y commits convencionales

scripts.format: pnpm run format:backend && pnpm run format:app
scripts.format:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format .
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:backend && pnpm run lint:app
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy
scripts.lint:app: cd app && dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test && flutter analyze --fatal-infos
scripts.test: pnpm run test:backend && pnpm run test:app
scripts.test:app: cd app && flutter test --coverage && node ../scripts/verificar-cobertura.mjs coverage/lcov.info 80
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test
scripts.admin:crear: docker compose run --rm api uv run --no-sync python -m app.features.cuentas.infrastructure.cli crear-admin
scripts.n8n:importar: docker compose exec -T n8n n8n import:workflow --separate --input=/flujos && docker compose exec -T n8n n8n publish:workflow --id=recoleccion-examenes && docker compose exec -T n8n n8n publish:workflow --id=recalibrar-conocimiento && docker compose restart n8n
